text.title: Product Explainability Failure Modes
text.summary: 13 antipatterns observed across deployments: KB drift modes and the gotchas of the explainability agent pipeline. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Product invisible in Perplexity / ChatGPT product comparisons.
antipattern.root-cause: schema.org markup absent on the product page.
antipattern.fix: Emit Product + SoftwareApplication JSON-LD; validate via product-kb-validate.sh.

antipattern.symptom: AI surfaces claim product does X (it doesn't); customers churn after trial.
antipattern.root-cause: Feature page listed capabilities only; no boundary statement.
antipattern.fix: Add 'what this does NOT do' section per feature page.

antipattern.symptom: AI summaries garble feature descriptions; sales gets 'what does this even do?' calls.
antipattern.fix: Rewrite to ≤grade 11 or move behind login.

antipattern.symptom: AI surfaces serve last quarter's feature set; reps lose deals on outdated info.
antipattern.root-cause: No machine-readable changelog; updates only land in marketing posts.
antipattern.fix: Publish RSS + JSON Feed changelog within 24h of every release.

antipattern.symptom: KB drift as default: marketing site, docs, pricing page, schema feed, and llms.txt diverge within weeks.
antipattern.root-cause: Each surface is edited by a different team on a different cadence. Without a single-source pipeline, contradiction is the natural state, not the exception.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule kb-json-single-source-of-truth; generate every surface from product-kb.json.

antipattern.symptom: Schema theater: teams add Product JSON-LD but description, audience, and feature fields repeat the marketing tagline.
antipattern.root-cause: Retrieval systems get no new signal from paraphrased copy. The schema markup must carry information not already in the page text.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule purpose-in-customer-language to every schema field; reject markup whose fields duplicate page copy.

antipattern.symptom: Capability-version skew: capability statements with no validFrom/validUntil dates.
antipattern.root-cause: Deprecated features keep getting recommended by AI assistants because there is no signal in the KB that they no longer exist. Date-bounded capability status is the fix.
Force a "no adjectives, no superlatives" constraint in the system prompt and lint generated output. These tokens provide no retrieval signal and reduce trust.
antipattern.fix: Add the no-adjectives constraint to the generator prompt and a lint step on its output.

antipattern.symptom: Extractor agent fabricating capabilities to fill empty fields.
antipattern.root-cause: Refuse-on-unknown must be enforced via prompt and post-hoc validator that cross-checks capability names against the feature flag registry or source code. Invented capabilities create support and legal liability.
antipattern.fix: Keep the "never fabricate" clause in the extraction prompt (05-examples.xml) and add the registry cross-check validator.

antipattern.symptom: Limit array lost across multi-step pipeline summarization passes.
antipattern.root-cause: Preserve the limits[] array verbatim across every pipeline stage. Never re-summarize limits — they carry legal and trust-critical precision that compression loses.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule limits-first-class; pass limits[] through untouched at every stage.

antipattern.symptom: Probe agents producing the same response across runs due to same prompt and cached model state.
antipattern.root-cause: Vary question phrasing, user role, and timing across probe runs. Stable scores are an artifact of caching, not real representation quality.
antipattern.fix: Rotate phrasing, role and timing per run; apply rule probe-three-frontier-models-weekly.

antipattern.symptom: Agent autonomously flipping a capability status to deprecated without human review.
antipattern.root-cause: Deprecated status removes a capability from AI-mediated discovery and directly impacts revenue. Always require product-owner sign-off; agents propose, humans approve the status change.
antipattern.fix: Gate every status change behind product-owner approval.

antipattern.symptom: Confidential information (unreleased features, internal vendor names, beta-only flags) in published KB.
antipattern.root-cause: Capability docs frequently leak internal details. Run a scrubber agent before any external publish — especially before pushing llms.txt or schema.org markup.
antipattern.fix: Insert a scrubber step before every external publish in the generator stage.
